questions.text: The president of the U.S. appoints the cabinet members, _____ appointments are subject to Senate approval.
questions.explanation: Dua klausa butuh connector yang bermakna pas. 'but' menyambung (kontras: presiden menunjuk, tetapi Senat menyetujui). 'because' tidak logis.
hints: Ada berapa klausa? Cek apakah ada connector yang tepat di antaranya.
Ada dua klausa. Connector mana yang artinya masuk akal?
Jawaban D. Dua klausa butuh connector yang bermakna pas. 'but' menyambung (kontras: presiden menunjuk, tetapi Senat menyetujui). 'because' tidak logis.

xray.marked: S{The president} P{of the U.S.} V{appoints} the cabinet members, C{but} S{their appointments} V{are} subject P{to Senate approval}.

questions.text: The prisoners were prevented from speaking to reporters because _____

options.text: not wanting the story in the papers.
the story in the papers the superintendent did not want
the public to hear the story
the superintendent did not want the story in the papers

questions.explanation: Setelah 'because' butuh klausa lengkap (subject + verb). Hanya D yang berurutan benar: subject 'the superintendent', verb 'did not want'.
hints: Ada berapa klausa? Cek apakah ada connector yang tepat di antaranya.
Setelah 'because' butuh subject dan verb. Mana yang lengkap dan berurutan benar?
Jawaban D. Setelah 'because' butuh klausa lengkap (subject + verb). Hanya D yang berurutan benar: subject 'the superintendent', verb 'did not want'.

xray.marked: S{The prisoners} V{were prevented} P{from speaking to reporters} C{because} S{the superintendent} V{did not want} the story P{in the papers}

questions.text: Like Thomas Berger's fictional character Little Big Man, Lauderdale managed to find himself where _____ of important events took place.
questions.explanation: 'where' sudah jadi connector. Verb 'took place' sudah ada, jadi yang kurang hanya subject: 'an extraordinary number'.
hints: Ada berapa klausa? Cek apakah ada connector yang tepat di antaranya.
Verb 'took place' sudah ada. Yang kosong berisi apa?
Jawaban C. 'where' sudah jadi connector. Verb 'took place' sudah ada, jadi yang kurang hanya subject: 'an extraordinary number'.

xray.marked: P{Like Thomas Berger's fictional character Little Big Man}, S{Lauderdale} V{managed} M{to find himself} C{where} S{an extraordinary number} P{of important events} V{took} place.

questions.text: _____ sucked groundwater from below, some parts of the city have begun to sink as much as ten inches annually.
questions.explanation: Klausa pertama butuh connector sebab-akibat: 'As'. 'So' tidak dipakai di awal kalimat begini, dan 'With pumps' tidak punya verb.
hints: Ada berapa klausa? Cek apakah ada connector yang tepat di antaranya.
Dua klausa dipisah koma. Apa yang hilang di klausa pertama?
Jawaban B. Klausa pertama butuh connector sebab-akibat: 'As'. 'So' tidak dipakai di awal kalimat begini, dan 'With pumps' tidak punya verb.

xray.marked: C{As} S{pumps} V{have sucked} groundwater P{from below}, S{some parts} P{of the city} V{have begun} M{to sink as much as ten inches annually}.

questions.text: Case studies are the target of much skepticism in the scientific community, _____ used extensively by numerous researchers.
questions.explanation: Setelah koma, klausa kedua butuh connector, subject, dan verb: 'yet they are'.
hints: Ada berapa klausa? Cek apakah ada connector yang tepat di antaranya.
Klausa kedua butuh tiga hal: connector, subject, verb. Mana yang punya semuanya?
Jawaban D. Setelah koma, klausa kedua butuh connector, subject, dan verb: 'yet they are'.

xray.marked: S{Case studies} V{are} the target P{of much skepticism} P{in the scientific community}, C{yet} S{they} V{are used} extensively P{by numerous researchers}.

questions.text: A cloud's reservoir of negative charge extends upward from the altitude at _____ the freezing point.
questions.explanation: Adjective clause setelah 'at' butuh connector 'which', lalu subject 'temperatures' dan verb 'hit'.
hints: Ada berapa klausa? Cek apakah ada connector yang tepat di antaranya.
Setelah 'at' butuh connector, subject, lalu verb dalam urutan biasa.
Jawaban C. Adjective clause setelah 'at' butuh connector 'which', lalu subject 'temperatures' dan verb 'hit'.

xray.marked: S{A cloud's reservoir} P{of negative charge} V{extends} upward P{from the altitude at} C{which} S{temperatures} V{hit} the freezing point.

questions.note: Kunci diturunkan dari analisis; opsi sudah dicocokkan ke gambar halaman.

questions.text: In a 1988 advanced officers' training program, Sampson developed a plan to incorporate police in enforcing environmental protection laws whenever _____ feasible.
questions.explanation: 'whenever' menyambung klausa baru yang butuh subject dan verb: 'it is feasible'.
hints: Ada berapa klausa? Cek apakah ada connector yang tepat di antaranya.
Setelah 'whenever' butuh subject dan verb sekaligus.
Jawaban A. 'whenever' menyambung klausa baru yang butuh subject dan verb: 'it is feasible'.

xray.marked: P{In a 1988 advanced officers' training program}, S{Sampson} V{developed} a plan M{to incorporate police in enforcing environmental protection laws} C{whenever} S{it} V{is} feasible.

questions.note: Kunci diturunkan dari analisis (bentuk singkat 'whenever feasible' juga lazim, tapi tidak ada di opsi).

questions.text: _____ will be carried in the next space shuttle payload has not yet been announced to the public.
questions.explanation: Seluruh bagian sampai 'payload' adalah subject dari 'has not yet been announced'. Noun clause dengan 'What' = 'the thing that'; verb 'will be carried' butuh subject dari connector itu.
hints: Ada berapa klausa? Cek apakah ada connector yang tepat di antaranya.
Verb utamanya 'has ... been announced'. Apa subject yang panjang itu?
Jawaban B. Seluruh bagian sampai 'payload' adalah subject dari 'has not yet been announced'. Noun clause dengan 'What' = 'the thing that'; verb 'will be carried' butuh subject dari connector itu.

xray.marked: S{What will be carried in the next space shuttle payload} V{has not yet been announced} P{to the public}.

questions.text: During free fall, _____ up to a full minute, a skydiver will fall at a constant speed of 120 m.p.h.
questions.explanation: Bagian di antara koma menerangkan 'free fall' dan punya verb sendiri, jadi butuh connector sekaligus subject: 'which is'.
hints: Ada berapa klausa? Cek apakah ada connector yang tepat di antaranya.
Bagian di antara koma punya verb 'is' dan menerangkan 'free fall'. Connector apa yang cocok?
Jawaban B. Bagian di antara koma menerangkan 'free fall' dan punya verb sendiri, jadi butuh connector sekaligus subject: 'which is'.

xray.marked: P{During free fall}, R{which} V{is} up to a full minute, S{a skydiver} V{will fall} at a constant speed P{of 120 m.p.h.}

questions.text: The fact _____ the most important ratings period is about to begin has caused all three networks to shore up their schedules.
questions.explanation: 'the fact' diikuti noun clause penjelas. Connectornya 'that', lalu klausa 'the most important ratings period is about to begin'.
hints: Ada berapa klausa? Cek apakah ada connector yang tepat di antaranya.
Setelah 'the fact' ada klausa lengkap. Connector paling sederhana?
Jawaban C. 'the fact' diikuti noun clause penjelas. Connectornya 'that', lalu klausa 'the most important ratings period is about to begin'.

xray.marked: S{The fact} C{that} S{the most important ratings period} V{is} about to begin V{has caused} all three networks M{to shore up their schedules}.
